correctness.rationale: Directly reconstructs the derivation identity A+A*=cI and idempotence equations; c=0 yields only zero, c=1 forces a hyperbolic decomposition into maximal isotropic image/kernel. Standard orthogonal-line double counting proves N_m=2 product_{i=1}^{m-1}(q^i+1); complements are skew-adjoint graphs, and q^m central functionals per projection. Central shears and Witt hyperbolic bases establish one conjugacy orbit. Exact script tests the defining equations in small fields; finite tests do not stand for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural infinite-family classification: whether idempotent derivations exist is exactly the orthogonal Witt-split condition, and both rank and conjugacy type are rigid. Finite-field counts are explicit in arbitrary even bilinear dimension and all odd prime powers. The distinction from alternating Heisenberg geometry is structural and the nonsplit obstruction is substantive, not merely a small computed slice.
